clue.text: Plans to get the atlas on the table

definitions.meaning: to plan something is to arrange it in detail in advance

definitions.text: get the atlas on the table
definitions.meaning: a literal picture of spreading charts flat for everyone to see

explanation.surface: Someone organising a trip starts by spreading the atlas across the table.
explanation.definitionFit: To map out a scheme is an idiom for planning it carefully; read literally, it is laying out your maps.

clue.text: Hound master of unyielding nature

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts degree
something unyielding is stiff

explanation.surface: A dog-owner who is a stubborn character.
explanation.definitionFit: The mastiff is a large, powerful breed of dog, an example of a hound in the loose sense.

clue.text: A musician could be prevaricating

definitions.meaning: a player keeps the beat, performing in tempo
stalling or being evasive to delay a decision

explanation.surface: A performer might be accused of stalling.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing for time is an idiom for stalling; a musician literally plays in time with the beat.

clue.text: Tropical plant depicted by fine artist

parts.note: OK means fine
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A tropical plant is painted by a good artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is a tropical plant grown for its edible green pods, known as ladies' fingers.

clue.text: Mean to hold on, now or very soon

indicators.note: to hold means the word for mean wraps round the other piece

parts.note: tight means mean or stingy
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone decides to cling on, now or soon.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonight is this evening, the present day's coming hours, so very soon.

clue.text: Select it for breaking up the soil

definitions.text: it for breaking up the soil
definitions.meaning: a pointed digging tool used on hard ground

explanation.surface: A gardener is told to choose the right tool for breaking up hard earth.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick is to choose; a pick (pickaxe) is the heavy pointed tool used to loosen hard ground.

clue.text: Drop in to deliver a batter pudding

definitions.meaning: a light hollow bun baked from egg batter

explanation.surface: Someone calls round to hand over a pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: To pop over is to visit briefly; a popover is a puffed-up baked item of egg batter.

clue.text: Salt should restore one to health

definitions.meaning: to preserve meat or fish with salt

explanation.surface: A salt remedy should make a patient well.
explanation.definitionFit: To cure is to preserve meat by salting or smoking, and to heal a sick person.

clue.text: Dress on time? Rubbish!

indicators.note: in a down clue on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: garb is dress or clothing
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at the notion of dressing to suit the times.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbage is waste, and figuratively nonsense, matching rubbish in both senses.

clue.text: Concerning chaste people in mainland Europe

parts.note: on means concerning or about
the continent means those who practise self-restraint, as 'the rich' means rich people

explanation.surface: A discussion of virtuous folk on the mainland.
explanation.definitionFit: British usage calls mainland Europe the Continent, so being there is being across the Channel.

clue.text: What a boxer needs, a spouse may not

definitions.text: What a boxer needs, a spouse may not

parts.words: What a boxer needs, a spouse may not
parts.note: a fighter trains against a practice opponent, while a husband or wife hopes for a mate who does not keep quarrelling

explanation.surface: A wry comparison between what a fighter wants in training and what a married person wants at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer's practice opponent has this name; read as a spouse, it is a partner who is always arguing.

clue.text: One knight returned to show the flag

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: returned means the word for the knight is read backwards

parts.note: a knight is addressed as Sir

explanation.surface: A single knight comes back carrying a banner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flag' is not a banner here: a flag is a kind of iris, the yellow flag of riverbanks. 'returned' turns SIR into RIS.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow flag is a wild iris, and flag is a general name for irises with sword-shaped leaves.

clue.text: Ohio will make donations for pointed window

parts.note: O is an old abbreviation for the US state of Ohio
to make donations is to give

explanation.surface: A US state promises to fund a new church window.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogive is a pointed Gothic arch, so it names a window with a pointed head.

clue.text: Stop to get a house in Washington

indicators.note: in means the house abbreviation sits inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: WA is the postal abbreviation for Washington state

explanation.surface: Someone halts their search to buy a home in Washington.
explanation.definitionFit: Whoa is the call to a horse, or anyone, to halt.

clue.text: A classic Midlands city

definitions.meaning: one of the five Classic English flat horse races
a city in the East Midlands of England

explanation.surface: A Midlands city described as traditional.
explanation.walkthrough: The Classics are five major English horse races; the Derby is run at Epsom.
explanation.definitionFit: The Derby is a Classic horse race named after an earl; Derby is also an English Midlands city.

clue.text: Writing endlessly to get extra shares

indicators.note: endlessly means the word for writing loses its last letter

parts.note: script is writing or handwriting

explanation.surface: Someone writes without stopping to obtain bonus stock.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrip issue gives shareholders additional stock in place of a cash dividend.

clue.text: Fantastic invention by FBI agents during attack

indicators.note: during means the agents come in the middle of the attack, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a fit is an attack of illness or temper
G-men is slang for FBI agents

explanation.surface: A tall story about federal agents caught up in an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: A figment is something the imagination has made up, a fantasy.

clue.text: About to use bike to save resources

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to use a bike is to cycle

explanation.surface: Someone plans to ride a bicycle to be kinder to the planet.
explanation.definitionFit: Recycling reprocesses waste so materials are used again, a way of conserving them.

clue.text: Gear left in Aussie mate's housing

indicators.note: housing means the Australian word holds the abbreviation for left inside it

parts.note: cobber is Australian slang for a mate or friend

explanation.surface: Some kit has been left at an Australian friend's place.
explanation.walkthrough: CLOBBER is British slang for clothes or kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Clobber is informal British for clothing and equipment, the same sense as gear.

clue.text: Bill gets left in centre of boat

indicators.note: in means the bill and left go inside the word for centre

parts.note: the core is the centre
AC (account) is a bill

explanation.surface: An invoice is found abandoned in the middle of a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre of boat' reads as one phrase, but 'centre' is CORE and 'boat' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A coracle is a small round boat of wicker and hide, used in Wales.

clue.text: Declined to see sporting arbiter exploited

parts.note: a ref, or referee, judges a sports match
exploited means used

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to visit a referee who was taken advantage of.
explanation.definitionFit: Refused means turned down, the same as declined.

clue.text: It protects locks from the rain

indicators.note: from tells us the answer is made out of these letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Something that keeps your hairdo safe from a downpour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a weak anagram signal: the letters of THE RAIN are remade into the answer. 'locks' are tresses, not bolts.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine mesh worn over the hair keeps a hairstyle in place, guarding the wearer's tresses.

clue.text: Diabolic man and I have intelligence

parts.note: he is a man
nous is common sense or intelligence

explanation.surface: A devilish fellow and I are clever.
explanation.definitionFit: Heinous means wicked in the extreme, as evil as something devilish.

clue.text: Couple's favourite turned up for the dance

parts.note: a couple is two, and the 's makes it two's

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the word for favourite is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a pet is a favourite

explanation.surface: A pair's preferred dance is announced.
explanation.definitionFit: The two-step is a ballroom dance with sliding steps.

clue.text: The liturgy must be utterly correct

indicators.note: utterly is read as by uttering, so the word for correct is spoken

parts.note: correct means right

explanation.surface: A churchgoer insists the service must be completely accurate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'utterly' looks like 'completely' but means 'when uttered', so RIGHT is said aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: A rite is a set form of religious ceremony, which is what a liturgy is.

clue.text: A priest with sex-appeal becomes a demon

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: An attractive clergyman turns out to be wicked.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for sex appeal comes from the 1920s 'It girl'.
explanation.definitionFit: An afrit is an evil spirit in Arabian folklore, a kind of devil.

clue.text: In amalfi local people sell pastry

indicators.note: In means the answer sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Townsfolk on the Amalfi coast run a bakery.
explanation.definitionFit: Filo is a paper-thin Greek pastry rolled in layers.

clue.text: Violet and Virginia take oral examination

parts.note: Vi is the short form of the name Violet
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: Two girls sit a spoken test.
explanation.definitionFit: A viva is a spoken exam at a university, short for viva voce.

clue.text: Rum fare for an infant

definitions.meaning: a yeast cake soaked in rum syrup

explanation.surface: Food with alcohol is offered to a baby.
explanation.walkthrough: A rum baba is a sponge soaked in rum; 'baba' is also a dialect word for a baby.
explanation.definitionFit: A baba is a rum-soaked yeast cake and also a word for a small child.

clue.text: Middleman means to award officer status to spy

parts.note: to commission someone is to make them an officer
a spy is an agent

explanation.surface: A go-between plans to promote a secret agent to officer rank.
explanation.walkthrough: A COMMISSION AGENT is also a British term for a bookmaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A commission agent buys or sells on behalf of others for a fee, acting as an intermediary.

clue.text: Comic appears in a suit

definitions.meaning: something found in hearts, spades, diamonds or clubs

explanation.surface: A comedian turns up wearing formal clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A card is a joker or wag; playing cards belong to the four suits of a pack.

clue.text: Celebrity set back from the beginning

parts.note: a celebrity is a star

indicators.note: back means the word for set is read backwards

parts.note: to set something down is to put it

explanation.surface: A famous person is delayed from the very start.
explanation.definitionFit: A start-up is the act of beginning, especially of a new business.
